thread:
alex: T-minus 2h to EU change window. Quiet window starts 21:00 UTC. Heads-up for any last-minute hotfixes. Please ack if you need an exemption.

mira: @alex ack from infra. Canary pool warmed on eu-west-1. Autoscaler set to conserve, burst disabled. I’ll monitor kernel queue.

sam: FYI I have a small embeddings hotfix pending tests. Would like autopin exemption if smoke passes :crossed_fingers: 

raja: Can we limit autopin to dedicated-capacity? Embedding paths spike cost. If allowed only to DC pool we reduce blast radius.

alex: Proposal: allow /pin-exempt for critical hotfixes only, requires 2 approvers (engineering + infra). Pin target must be explicit (dedicated/private). Rollback threshold: token-error-rate > 1.5% sustained 5m OR latency p95 > 3s on canary -> rollback.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: quiet-window locks feature toggles at 21:00 UTC. Use /unfreeze to request emergency unpin with full justification.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/v2.1.3 (commit d4f3a2). Canary target: 2% traffic on eu-west-1 dedicated. Metric watchers: errors, latency, cost-per-token.

sam: smoke done, embedding hotfix passes local and staging. Submitting /pin-exempt now.

alex: Checklist (copy + paste into your ops message):
```
- Confirmed canary pool warmed (infra)
- Canary traffic target set (release owner)
- Autoscaler set to conservative (infra)
- Approvals recorded (2 approvers for pin-exempt)
- Rollback owners listed (oncall + release lead)
- Monitoring dashboards up (slo, errors, p95)
- Post-deploy smoke script run (QA)
```

raja: Approved pin-exempt for sam (infra). @mira please confirm capacity isolation :thumbsup:

mira: Confirmed isolation to dedicated pool, no cross-tenant pin. Monitoring dashboards live. :thumbsup:

alex: OK. Proceed with autopin to dedicated pool. Anyone else? If no objections by 20:50 UTC we close exemptions and enter quiet window.

sam: thanks team. proceeding. will report smoke in 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary traffic ramped to 2% at 1716512500. Metrics: errors 0.1%, p95 180ms.

alex: Great. Leaving this thread open for incident triggers. If rollback needed follow rollback playbook and ping #release-war-room.
